findings.evidence: The 'uncaughtException' pattern matches minified React runtime error handling code (Error class with .stack property). The app's only error handling is an ErrorBoundary.tsx and an unhandledrejection listener in main.tsx, both limited to local console.error logging. No third-party crash reporting SDK (Crashlytics, Sentry, etc.) is integrated — confirmed by package.json dependency review.
findings.recommendation: No action required. Crash log data remains on-device and is not transmitted off-device. To maintain compliance, ensure no crash reporting SDK is added without proper disclosure.
